literal: Cruel person's cruelty will tell, with bangles, former beauty faded shoulders.
translation: My shoulders, which have lost their bangles and their former beauty, proclaim the cruelty of my cruel lover.
modern: வளையல்கள் கழன்று பழைய அழகும் கெட்டு வாடிப்போன என் தோள்கள், என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்த காதலரின் கொடுமையை உலகத்தார்க்குச் சொல்லும்.
explanation: The speaker laments the physical toll of her lover's absence. Her shoulders have grown so thin that her bangles slip off, and their natural, former beauty has faded. This visible wasting away acts as a silent but clear messenger, proclaiming the cruelty of the lover who abandoned her. The phrase 'தொடியொடு' (with bangles) vividly captures how both her adornments and her innate beauty are lost together.
